hook.rumour: In the farming village of Vos beneath Tel Vos's twisted roots, wickwheat growers and Zainab scouts accuse each other of poisoning the grazing springs while kwama mines go rabid.
hook.notice: DECREE OF MASTER ARYON AT TEL VOS — Investigators sought to examine the fouled watering-runs between Vos, Zainab Camp, and Mudan-Mul Egg Mine.
hook.context: The Grazelands are Vvardenfell's golden breadbasket, shared uneasily between Master Aryon's progressive Telvanni retainers at Vos and the wealthy Zainab and Ahemmusa Ashlander clans.

stages.objective: Speak with the village elders at Vos about the blighted irrigation channels
Consult Master Aryon's steward in the Imperial-fungal hybrid tower of Tel Vos
Parley with the Zainab herd-wardens at Zainab Camp regarding the poisoned guar-wallows

objectives.text: Speak with the village elders at Vos about the blighted irrigation channels
Consult Master Aryon's steward in the Imperial-fungal hybrid tower of Tel Vos
Parley with the Zainab herd-wardens at Zainab Camp regarding the poisoned guar-wallows

consequence_detail.summary: Both Vos farmers and Zainab herders are cleared of blame when alchemical sediment in the springs is traced to Mudan-Mul Egg Mine.

stages.objective: Clear the blighted kwama warriors inside Mudan-Mul Egg Mine and seal the leaking Dwemer pipe
Seek the Wise Woman's counsel at Ahemmusa Camp on the source of the subterranean conduit
Obtain a brass valve-key from the apothecaries of Tel Mora

objectives.text: Clear the blighted kwama warriors inside Mudan-Mul Egg Mine and seal the leaking Dwemer pipe
Seek the Wise Woman's counsel at Ahemmusa Camp on the source of the subterranean conduit
Obtain a brass valve-key from the apothecaries of Tel Mora

consequence_detail.summary: The leaking pipe in Mudan-Mul Egg Mine is capped, and the Tel Mora valve-key points to the Dwemer pumping vaults of Nchardahrk.

stages.objective: Enter the flooded Dwemer halls of Nchardahrk and shut down the corrupted blight-cistern
Clear the cultist saboteurs camped in the outer gallery of Mzuleft
Recover the stolen Zainab grazing-totem from the shore ruins of Ald Daedroth

objectives.text: Enter the flooded Dwemer halls of Nchardahrk and shut down the corrupted blight-cistern
Clear the cultist saboteurs camped in the outer gallery of Mzuleft
Recover the stolen Zainab grazing-totem from the shore ruins of Ald Daedroth

consequence_detail.summary: The corrupted Dwemer cistern at Nchardahrk is shut down and the stolen Zainab grazing-totem is recovered from Ald Daedroth.

stages.objective: Return the grazing-totem to Ashkhan Kaushad's hearth at Zainab Camp
Witness Master Aryon's Mouth and the Ashlander envoys seal the Savannah Grazing Compact at Tel Vos
Celebrate the reopening of the clean cistern-wells with the farmers of Vos

objectives.text: Return the grazing-totem to Ashkhan Kaushad's hearth at Zainab Camp
Witness Master Aryon's Mouth and the Ashlander envoys seal the Savannah Grazing Compact at Tel Vos
Celebrate the reopening of the clean cistern-wells with the farmers of Vos

consequence_detail.summary: Clean water flows once more into Vos's wickwheat terraces, and the Savannah Grazing Compact binds Tel Vos and the Ashlander clans in peace.
